properties.displayName: Entra - High-Risk OAuth Consent or Application Permission Grant
properties.description: [Added 2026 threat-model expansion] Detects successful application consent or permission grants containing high-impact Microsoft Graph/M365 permissions commonly abused for persistence, mailbox access, data collection, or privilege escalation.
properties.query:
let HighRiskPermissions = dynamic([
  'RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory','Directory.ReadWrite.All','Application.ReadWrite.All','AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All',
  'Mail.ReadWrite','Mail.ReadWrite.All','Mail.Send','Files.ReadWrite.All','Sites.ReadWrite.All','Sites.FullControl.All',
  'Group.ReadWrite.All','User.ReadWrite.All','offline_access'
]);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where Result =~ 'success'
| where Category =~ 'ApplicationManagement'
| where OperationName in~ ('Consent to application','Add delegated permission grant','Add app role assignment to service principal')
| mv-expand TargetResource=TargetResources
| extend TargetAppName=tostring(TargetResource.displayName), TargetAppId=tostring(TargetResource.id),
         PermissionEvidence=strcat(tostring(TargetResource.modifiedProperties),' ',tostring(AdditionalDetails))
| where PermissionEvidence has_any (HighRiskPermissions)
| extend InitiatingUserPrincipalName=tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
         InitiatingAadUserId=tostring(InitiatedBy.user.id), InitiatingAppName=tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName),
         InitiatingAppServicePrincipalId=tostring(InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId),
         InitiatingIpAddress=tostring(coalesce(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress,InitiatedBy.app.ipAddress))
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, TargetAppName, TargetAppId, InitiatingUserPrincipalName, InitiatingAadUserId,
          InitiatingAppName, InitiatingAppServicePrincipalId, InitiatingIpAddress, PermissionEvidence, CorrelationId
